candidate.title: MTU auto-detection will now use the lowest MTU of all external interfaces
candidate.text: MTU auto-detection will now use the lowest MTU of all external interfaces. Before, only the primary interface was considered. One exception to this is in ENI mode where the secondary interfaces are not considered for MTU auto-detection. MTU can still be configured manually via the `MTU` helm option, `--mtu` agent flag or `mtu` option in CNI configuration.

evidence.excerpt:
* MTU auto-detection will now use the lowest MTU of all external interfaces. Before, only the primary
  interface was considered. One exception to this is in ENI mode where the secondary interfaces are not
  considered for MTU auto-detection. MTU can still be configured manually via the `MTU` helm option,
  `--mtu` agent flag or `mtu` option in CNI configuration.
